name: Terraform Provider for Fabric V1.12.0
description: # Fabric Terraform Provider Changes## New Resources and Data Sources| Feature | Type | Description ||---|---|---|| `fabric_onelake_data_access_security` | Data source | Added support for retrieving OneLake Data Access Security configuration || `fabric_onelake_data_access_security` | Resource | Added support for managing OneLake Data Access Security configuration || `fabric_mirrored_catalog` | Resource | Added support for managing Mirrored Catalog resources || `fabric_mirrored_catalog` | Data source | Added support for retrieving a Mirrored Catalog || `fabric_mirrored_catalogs` | Data source | Added support for retrieving multiple Mirrored Catalogs |## Enhancements| Feature | Type | Description ||---|---|---|| Tags support in `fabric_item` data source | Enhancement | Added support for retrieving tags associated with Fabric items || Tags support in `fabric_item` resource | Enhancement | Added support for managing tags associated with Fabric items |## SummaryThis update expands Fabric Terraform provider capabilities with:- OneLake Data Access Security management support- Mirrored Catalog resource and data source support- Improved metadata management through Fabric item tag support
